results.description:
What happens on tour doesn't stay on tour. Not when she's your best friend's little sister and you're a world famous rock star.

She's the definition of forbidden—my best friend's little sister.

I've done my best to put distance between us.

Ella is just too damn tempting.

Good thing she's going on tour with us.

And following us around with her camera.

And sleeping on our bus.

No way is this gonna end well.

Refrain is the second book of the Tin Gods Rock Stars series. Grab this angsty best friend's little sister, forbidden romance about a frustrated rock star and the girl next door he's been in love with for forever—he just doesn't know it yet.
